title: cutest app for adhd girlies
body: i’ve been using this app for over a year and recently upgraded to the premium version. i was getting out of a rough patch and decided to commit to the premium version after a year of the free version and honestly i don’t regret it. this app helps a lot with setting small tasks to get done and the reminder alert is the best. as someone who usually forgets my reminders after a while, the app keeps sending you notifications until you manually switch it off. some might find it annoying but i find it incredibly useful. my favourite function is the daily journal as you can get a “letter from roubit” which is incredibly comforting especially if you’ve had a tough day. the gacha system is very simple and very cute so it satisfies the need for dopamine. the free version is okay if you’re still unsure if you want to get the full version but i highly recommend the premium. the unlimited routines really make all the difference (especially if you want to collect limited themes fast)
author: zhokae
